lists.of: question about possible causes of an illusion
items: 30. Could the illusion of human equality : be caused by : man's perceptual or intellectual limitations?
31. Could the illusion of human perfection : be caused by : confusion?
32. Could the illusion of human rationality : be caused by : hierarchy (multiplicity of confusing and interfering levels)?
33. Could the illusion of human redundancy : be caused by : conceptual poverty?
34. Could the illusion of human simplicity : be caused by : misclassification or misidentification?
35. Could the illusion of human wisdom : be caused by : wanton desire?
36. Could the illusion of instantaneous body-world interaction : be caused by : misestimation (poor quantification)?

37. Could the illusion of instantaneous light transmission : be caused by : unconstrained imagination or 'pseudo-perception' (spurious acts of perception that are assumed to have occurred but that in fact did not occur)?
38. Could the illusion of intrinsic color : be caused by : multidimensionality?
39. Could the illusion of knowledge greater than man's ignorance : be caused by : false or inadequate world view?
40. Could the illusion of linear progress : be caused by : misdescription, under-description, or under-perception?
41. Could the illusion of linear relationships : be caused by : random patterns, coincidences, juxtapositions, or 'background noise'?

42. Could the illusion of mathematical points : be caused by : ignorance about illusion in general (its diversity, categories, taxa, omnipresence, signs, causes, genesis, laws, instances and spectrum of exemplifications, transformations, transcendence, degrees, related phenomena, etc)?

43. Could the illusion of micro-temporal continuity of matter : be caused by : unconstrained imagination or 'pseudo-perception' (spurious acts of perception that are assumed to have occurred but that in fact did not occur)?
44. Could the illusion of most of the cosmos visible : be caused by : hierarchy (multiplicity of confusable and interfering levels)?
45. Could the illusion of natural anomalies rare : be caused by : confusion?

46. Could the illusion of non-analogous things : be caused by : ignorance about illusion in general (its diversity, categories, taxa, omnipresence, signs, causes, genesis, laws, instances and spectrum of exemplifications, transformations, transcendence, degrees, related phenomena, etc)?
47. Could the illusion of non-peculiarity of self : be caused by : pseudo-averaging (attempted averaging of what cannot be averaged)?
48. Could the illusion of normality : be caused by : overgeneralization, exaggeration, infinitization, absolutization, non-qualification, eternalization, idealization, etc?
49. Could the illusion of objective self-image : be caused by : misrepresentation or mistreatment?
50. Could the illusion of omniscience : be caused by : mass delusion or other related idol?
51. Could the illusion of opaque matter : be caused by : unwillingness to doubt or to consider the possibility of illusion; complacency?
52. Could the illusion of perfection in nature : be caused by : absence of a touchstone?
53. Could the illusion of physical reality of any mathematical object : be caused by : absence of a touchstone?
54. Could the illusion of placid matter : be caused by : continuity?
55. Could the illusion of political power : be caused by : superficiality?
56. Could the illusion of prosaic nature of existence : be caused by : interference?
57. Could the illusion of pure reason : be caused by : 'mental excuses'?

58. Could the illusion of purely macroscopic world : be caused by : neglect of scientific procedures (testing, experimentation, prediction, validation, reproduction, statistical evaluation, induction, deduction, rich hypothecation, etc)?
59. Could the illusion of reliability of common sense : be caused by : unwillingness to doubt or to consider the possibility of illusion; complacency?
60. Could the illusion of reliability of experimental data : be caused by : psychophysical boundary values, objective similarity, non-discrimination, under-differentiation, or mis-analogy?
61. Could the illusion of reliability of intuition : be caused by : reliance on a single system?
62. Could the illusion of reliability of mass opinion : be caused by : monoideism (excessive preoccupation with a single, fixed idea)?
63. Could the illusion of reliability of orthodoxy : be caused by : persistence despite (or actually via) transformation (meta-continuity)?
64. Could the illusion of reliability of 'proofs' : be caused by : reification or hypostatization?
65. Could the illusion of reliability of the senses : be caused by : reification or hypostatization?
